meta.name: init-deep
meta.description: Initializes a hierarchical AGENTS.md knowledge base for a project. Use when a repo needs its structure, commands, and conventions documented for agents.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为项目生成分层说明文件,让 AI 编程助手读懂代码结构、命令与约定
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你希望 AI 助手在大型代码库里按目录逐步理解项目并遵循团队约定
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want AI agents to understand a large codebase by directory and follow team conventions

howto.what: 它会为项目生成分层的 AGENTS.md 知识库:一个根文件,加上按复杂度评分挑选出的子目录文件,记录项目结构、命令与约定。
howto.when: 当仓库需要把结构、命令和约定记录下来给 agent 使用时触发;你手动运行 /init-deep 也会进入。

say.text: 用 /init-deep 给这个仓库生成 AGENTS.md
say.note: 默认更新模式,已有文件会被修改
删除现有 AGENTS.md 后重新生成

howto.what_en: It generates a hierarchical AGENTS.md knowledge base for the project: one root file plus complexity-scored subdirectory files covering structure, commands and conventions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a repo needs its structure, commands and conventions documented for agents; running /init-deep manually also starts it.

say_en.text: Run /init-deep to generate AGENTS.md for this repo
say_en.note: Default update mode edits existing files

say_en.text: /init-deep --create-new, read the old files then rebuild
